description: Scenarios of fake-playwright.cjs. Every scenario is the positive notes app with the listed part changed, and the server keeps the typed token wherever the scenario allows, so only the changed part can stop the promotion. The verdict is the probe's persistence_after_reload; the steps are the commit witness steps the probe records.

scenarios.name: recorded_content_q
scenarios.covers: L-137 content-q marker sequence: POST, typing, PUT, reload to the list, the same id and token in the read

scenarios.name: synthetic_renamed
scenarios.covers: the positive with other state keys, mode values and resource paths

scenarios.name: l135_editor_after_reload
scenarios.covers: L-135 content-g: PUT 200 and the same editor and preview after the reload

scenarios.name: save_without_change
scenarios.covers: the save API is called without the typed change

scenarios.name: dirty_only
scenarios.covers: the save press only clears dirty

scenarios.name: count_only
scenarios.covers: only the record count matches after the reload

scenarios.name: stale_token
scenarios.covers: an old probe token is in the list and the read

scenarios.name: create_post_only
scenarios.covers: only the first creating POST succeeded

scenarios.name: autosave_only
scenarios.covers: only an autosave while typing carried the token

scenarios.name: late_response
scenarios.covers: a request started before the press answers during the press

scenarios.name: cross_origin
scenarios.covers: the save went to another origin

scenarios.name: other_resource
scenarios.covers: the save went to a resource the read does not name

scenarios.name: readback_without_token
scenarios.covers: the read after the reload has no token

scenarios.name: list_without_token
scenarios.covers: the list after the reload has no token

scenarios.name: entry_only_after_reload
scenarios.covers: the token is only inside a contenteditable after the reload

scenarios.name: preview_only
scenarios.covers: only a preview of the local draft shows the token after the reload

scenarios.name: hidden_only
scenarios.covers: the token is only in a hidden node after the reload

scenarios.name: local_storage_draft
scenarios.covers: the save only writes local storage and the list renders it

scenarios.name: http_4xx
scenarios.covers: the save answers 409

scenarios.name: http_5xx
scenarios.covers: the save answers 500

scenarios.name: request_failed
scenarios.covers: the save request fails

scenarios.name: reload_failed
scenarios.covers: the reload fails

scenarios.name: save_timeout
scenarios.covers: the save never answers

scenarios.name: token_before_entry
scenarios.covers: the token was on the page before typing

scenarios.name: url_echo
scenarios.covers: the token is echoed in the page URL

scenarios.name: readback_exact_without_token
scenarios.covers: D2: the read of the saved resource has lost the token and the page does not show it
